name: WDC Products Hardware Listings Downsampled Source-Schema Variant 3 (PascalCase)
description: Hardware product listings from the WDC Products benchmark, with structured attributes taken from the original LLM extraction before downstream normalization. No downstream brand mapping, unit conversion, numeric parsing, rounding or text cleanup is applied. Some conversions already performed by the extraction model remain. Column names retain the source schema, but unit suffixes are not guarantees of the raw units; use the original title and description for unit context. The redundant combined title-description column has been removed and rows are independently shuffled
